title: The Friend Zone
author: Abby Jimenez
summary: A woman who has decided she cannot have children falls for her friend's brother, who badly wants a family. Their easy flirting meets some hard questions about what each of them is willing to give up.
readIf: you like romances that mix laugh-out-loud humour with some real, honest emotional stakes.
skipIf: you want pure fluff, since this one gets serious about health, family and difficult choices.

pairings.reason: Another friends-to-lovers story where humour covers some real hurt and unspoken feelings.
Both pair a romance with weighty life decisions, although Me Before You ends up much sadder.
A funny romance with a heroine dealing frankly with her health and what she wants from life.
